C0226.title: US Government Websites Hit by SEO Poisoning Attack
C0226.summary: In December 2025, Cybernews and SC Media reported that .gov domains across multiple U.S. states and local governments were affected by an SEO poisoning attack. Attackers used public forms or file-upload functions on government sites to place PDFs and similar content containing malicious links. After those attachments were indexed by search engines such as Google, users clicking official-domain results were redirected to AI-porn ads, chatbots, adult products, or other illicit pages. The reports cited at least 38 .gov sites across 18 states, and government website vendor Granicus said it had blocked public access to uploaded documents.
